remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks and Whitney Archive indicate, "Painted 1923. Exam. at Amer. Place, 1946. . . . No signature." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: In O'Keeffe writing: 'Single Alligator Pear' – 22? Initials and star" [not verified]. Pictured in 1924 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 25. O'Keeffe wrote, "The best of the alligator pears was a pastel of my first lone dry pear on a white cloth" (*Georgia O'Keeffe* [1976], unpaginated, text accompanying entry 31). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
